thresholds.switch: No switch is permitted until measurable semantic, authority/schema, end-to-end latency, and realized-TCO thresholds are owner-frozen; then Qwen3-14B requires zero authority/schema guardrail failures, no material semantic regression, and compliance with those thresholds.
thresholds.scale: Scale only when measured KV pressure, queue delay, TTFT, or concurrency exceeds an owner-frozen SLO; scale-to-zero only when idle savings exceed burst load overhead within the latency SLO.
thresholds.escalate: Escalate rather than silently quantize or add nodes when identities cannot be reproduced, usable KV does not fit, schema output fails with reasoning, privacy/license remains open, or neither candidate clears semantic and cost gates.
